channel.title: ForeverYoung
channel.description: Driving into the distance — notes on ML, CUDA, Python, and beyond.

item.title: Data Visualization with Hand-Drawn/Sketchy Style
item.description: A survey of tools for creating hand-drawn/sketchy style data visualizations: rough.js, draw.io, matplotlib xkcd, chart.xkcd, and cutecharts.

item.title: Model Size vs. Inference Speed in Deep Learning
item.description: An examination of how FLOPs, parameter count, memory access volume, and memory footprint affect inference speed, with practical network design recommendations for different hardware platforms.

item.title: Learning Strategies for Patch-Based Local Descriptors
item.description: A survey of data processing and training strategies for learned image local descriptors, focusing on what distinguishes different approaches to patch-based learning.

item.title: pybind11: Python Bindings for C++/CUDA Code
item.description: Using pybind11 to create Python bindings for C++/CUDA code, with zero-copy conversion between numpy/torch tensors and Eigen/cv::Mat.

item.title: Numba: Accelerating Python Code with Simple Decorators
item.description: An introduction to using numba's decorators for just-in-time compilation to speed up Python functions — easy to use, flexible, and effective.

item.title: Preprocess the Image Data by NPP in TensorRT Model Inference
item.description: How to use NVIDIA NPP library to accelerate image preprocessing (uint8→float32) for TensorRT model inference pipelines.

item.title: Numba: Learning CUDA Programming Quickly with Python
item.description: A fast introduction to CUDA's multithreaded, highly concurrent programming model using Python's numba library, designed to lower the barrier for beginners.
